title: Design: Not Tracked in the Inventory list looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with stock in one bin and a saved Min and Max.
  • Have a tracked part, part B, with stock.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design pictures of boards 5.3 and 5.4 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with them.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Scroll the table to the right until the Min column shows.
  3. Replace the search text with not tracked.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Part A's Total Qty cell reads "Not Tracked" in light grey plain text, with no coloured badge around it.
  • Part B's Total Qty cell shows a coloured badge with its quantity and the word Available.
  • Part A's Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows the outlined chip with its bin and quantity.
  • Part A's Min and Max cells still show numbers.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed, with the same grey "Not Tracked" text in Total Qty.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part), story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S4-R8: “An untracked part shows "Not Tracked" in the Inventory list's Total Qty column instead of a quantity.”
  • S4-R8a: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Bin Location / Quantity column still shows each bin with its quantity.”
  • S4-R8b: “On the Inventory list, an untracked part's Min and Max columns still show the saved values.”
  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked", "not" or "tracked" in the Inventory search returns the untracked parts, together with every part those words match on part number, description, tags and the other standard fields. Upper and lower case, and spaces before and after the term, do not matter.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "5.3 The list says Not Tracked", "5.4 Finding untracked parts".
